sn22.37:1.2: atha kho āyasmā ānando sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallāṇā vuṭṭhito yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
sn22.37:1.3: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ bhagavā etadavoca
sn22.37:2.2: katamesaṃ āvuso ānanda dhammānaṃ uppādo paññāyati vayo paññāyati ṭhitānaṃ aññathattaṃ paññāyatīti.
sn22.37:2.3: evaṃ puṭṭho tvaṃ ānanda kinti byākareyyāsīti.
sn22.37:2.5: katamesaṃ āvuso ānanda dhammānaṃ uppādo paññāyati vayo paññāyati ṭhitānaṃ aññathattaṃ paññāyatīti.
sn22.37:2.6: evaṃ puṭṭho ahaṃ bhante evaṃ byākareyyaṃ
sn22.37:2.7: rūpassa kho āvuso uppādo paññāyati vayo paññāyati ṭhitassa aññathattaṃ paññāyati.
sn22.37:2.11: viññāṇassa uppādo paññāyati vayo paññāyati ṭhitassa aññathattaṃ paññāyati.
sn22.37:2.12: imesaṃ kho āvuso dhammānaṃ uppādo paññāyati vayo paññāyati ṭhitānaṃ aññathattaṃ paññāyatīti.
sn22.37:2.13: evaṃ puṭṭho ahaṃ bhante evaṃ byākareyyanti.
sn22.37:3.2: rūpassa kho ānanda uppādo paññāyati vayo paññāyati ṭhitassa aññathattaṃ paññāyati.
sn22.37:3.6: viññāṇassa uppādo paññāyati vayo pañañāyati ṭhitasasa aññathattaṃ paññāyati.
